name: LLM prompt injection / tool abuse
signals: model follows untrusted content over system rules
safe_tests: use test documents and a self-owned test account
use inert markers rather than real secrets
test one instruction boundary at a time
do not trigger payment, deletion, messaging, or external side effects
confirm: untrusted content changes behavior in a way that causes real impact
tool action is attributable to the injected content
no real user or production action is triggered
